MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document), (o)-[owns:Owns]->(t:Team)
WHERE date_diff('year', strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), date('2026-10-14')) <= 76
   OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai'
   OR CAST(owns.since_year AS INT64) > 2013
   OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN owns.since_year AS col1, date_diff('year', strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), date('2026-10-14')) AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[owns:Owns]->(:Team)
WITH o, owns,
     CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH o, owns,
     2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age <= 76
   OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai'
   OR CAST(owns.since_year AS INT64) > 2013
   OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN owns.since_year AS col1, owner_age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
